items.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
items.snippet: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
items.snippet: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.
